dedupe_keys.name: glors global long term reservoir sedimentation dataset

description: GLoRS supplies annual estimates of reservoir sedimentation and storage-capacity loss for 1,413 major reservoirs worldwide from 1984 to 2023. Sanchit Minocha and Faisal Hossain at the University of Washington publish the dataset and the notebooks used to generate it with the RECLAIM method. Satellite observations and in-situ records support machine-learning estimates of annual sedimentation. The GitHub documentation describes CSV and GeoJSON outputs, and the public OSF file metadata identifies a version 1.0 ZIP archive. Spatial resolution is the individual reservoir; temporal resolution is annual. OSF licenses the dataset under CC BY 4.0, with free public access. These values are model-based estimates, not direct sediment surveys of every reservoir in every year. Coverage is limited to the included major reservoirs. The describing manuscript is labelled under review in the README, so publication is not assumed. Simulation uses include reservoir-capacity planning and assessing long-term storage loss under changing catchment conditions. GLoRS complements data-grsr-global-reservoir-sedimentation-rate and uses inputs generated with model-rat-reservoir-assessment-tool. The review did not test numerical agreement between these resources.
